premise.finding: The reporting page lists audited GPFS for FY2016-17 through FY2025-26 (10 years), plus FY2015-16 statements for the former Dubbo City and former Wellington councils, annual reports and IP&R/budget documents. Multiple current and historical GPFS therefore exist; the premise is true.

reconciliation_basis: Printed $ '000. Face income statement components are summed and compared with the printed total, then compared with note B1-1 Total functions and activities. No dollar derivation and no cross-council sum.

recommendations: Keep one source id dubbo-council-gpfs and add fiscal-year parameterisation instead of creating per-year source ids; use context.document.fiscal_year everywhere mapLine currently hard-codes DUBBO_GPFS_FISCAL_YEAR.
Do not ingest annual reports, former-council statements or budget/forward forecasts as council-wide actuals: they overlap or use a different measure type.
FY2024-25 is already builder-ready. Add layout variants for FY2023-24 (single total expenses line) and FY2025-26 (net gain on disposal revenue line) before ingesting those years.
Defer FY2016-17 to FY2022-23 until each layout is inspected; 2016-17 is a 13 May 2016 to 30 June 2017 partial period with amalgamation transfer/gain lines.

builder_brief.target: Extend dubbo-council-gpfs to FY2023-24 and FY2025-26 (and optionally earlier years) with one council only.
builder_brief.input: Archived PDF path and SHA-256 from this packet; discover the document from the reporting page by fiscal year (no hard-coded document URL).
builder_brief.unit_gate: Require the printed $'000 header. Reject if absent.
builder_brief.face_lines: Select lines by exact printed labels; add a per-year layout spec rather than one global line list.
builder_brief.reconciliation: Sum printed revenue components to the printed total income; sum printed expense components (including the printed D&A line) to the printed total expenses; compare both with B1-1 Total functions and activities (income, expenses, result, grants). Refuse ingestion on any mismatch.
builder_brief.olge_anchor: Use the existing OLG FY2024-25 revenue/expense anchors where the year matches; do not invent anchors for other years.
builder_brief.rows: Emit non-additive agency_detail actual rows for total revenue, total expenses, net result, employee expenses, D&A and grant components; never create region/LGA allocation and never sum across councils or across measure types.
builder_brief.tests: Golden-file tests from the archived byte sequence for each supported year, including a rejection test for the wrong layout and a unit-missing test.
